metadata.title: Guidelines on the Safety and Vigilance of Health Products and Technologies (Pharmacy and Poisons Board)
metadata.edition: HPT/PDS/VMS/GUD/022 Rev. No. 03, October 2025 (published_on 1 October 2025 is a placeholder day) · 6.1 local fatal 7, serious 15, non-serious 30 calendar days; foreign cases in the PSUR/PBRER; 6.2 PSUR 70/90 calendar days
metadata.legal_basis: PPB guideline under the Pharmacy and Poisons Act (Cap. 244) and the Pharmacovigilance and Post Market Surveillance Rules 2022; the Act and Rules prevail.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
